documents.title: Board Meeting Outcome for Outcome Of The Board Meeting Of Bhageria Industries Limited Held On 28Th October, 2026.
Board Meeting Intimation for Approval Of Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended September 30, 2026

analysis.summary: Bhageria Industries Limited reported its Q2 and H1 FY26 financial and operational performance during the earnings conference call. Management highlighted strong revenue growth and high capacity utilization across plants, supported by firm demand and exports, despite margin pressures from raw material prices. The company is expanding its H-ACID capacity at Tarapur and entering the polymer specialty additive space with commercial production of plasticizers. Furthermore, management outlined strategic initiatives in the pharmaceutical segment, including regulatory filings for Dexamethasone and Methylcobalamin, alongside investments in renewable solar energy. Bhageria Industries Limited reported its financial and operational performance for Q2 and H1 FY22, highlighting revenue growth driven by higher volumes alongside margin pressures from increased input, freight, and power costs.

guidance.claim: Management expects full year chemical segment revenue to be between Rs. 725 crores and Rs. 775 crores.
The incremental H-ACID capacity is expected to generate an additional Rs. 50 to Rs. 75 crores in annual revenue at present prices once fully operational.
guidance.quote: With the plant already operating at about 95% utilization, the incremental capacity is expected to generate Rs. 50-Rs. 75 crores additional annual revenue at present price, once fully operational.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that current capacity utilization across plants is about 95% to 97% of installed capacity.
demand_outlook.quote: The current utilization is about 95%-97% of production, installed capacity.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that demand is good and expressed expectations that Q4 will be much better than the current quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand is good. And in Q4, we are thinking it will be much better than this.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that export orders are currently very good and performing well for November and December.
demand_outlook.quote: No. At present, it is very good and we think for November-December, it is good.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated they do not face any competitive threat from China at present.
demand_outlook.quote: No one. We don't have any threat from China, at least for now.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production of the new product line Plasticizers is set to commence by the end of December 25.
capex_expansion.quote: Within a short period, the company announced the commencement of commercial production of a new product line, Plasticizers by the end of December 25, working on the first place is working with the product collection and marketing at the Tarapur facility and the expansion of H-ACID capacity at the same location.

capex_expansion.claim: The plasticizer facility has a capacity of 2,000 tons per month with an approximate investment of Rs. 10 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: It is approximately Rs. 10 Cr, which has been done already.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the pharmaceutical segment Capex of around Rs. 30 to Rs. 35 crores has already been completed.
capex_expansion.quote: So the CAPEX, I think we have already done, which is around Rs. 30-Rs. 35 Cr, which has already been done.

capex_expansion.claim: The board approved the acquisition of a 51% equity share in Bhageria & Jajodia Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd.
capex_expansion.quote: Board approved acquisition of 51% equity shares of Bhageria & Jajodia Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. ('BJPPL'), leading the way for Company to enter pharma segment

margins_costs.claim: Management explained that margins shrunk because of higher raw material prices impacted by the US and other European countries.
margins_costs.quote: The revenue came from the chemical sector, whereas the margins have shrunk because of the higher raw material prices due to the impact of the US and other European countries. The margins have shrunk actually.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects margin improvement of 2% to 3% going forward.
margins_costs.quote: It is about 2%-3% which will increase. Yes.

margins_costs.claim: Cost of Goods Sold for Q1 FY22 was Rs 69.0 crore compared to Rs 28.7 crore in Q1 FY21.
Employee Benefit Expense for Q1 FY22 was reported at Rs 4.0 crore.
Other Expenses for Q1 FY22 stood at Rs 17.9 crore.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's annual capacities for H-ACID, Vinyl Sulfone, and Gamma-Acid are 4,800 tons, 3,600 tons, and 1,200 tons respectively.
orders_capacity.quote: H-ACID is about 4,800 tons per annum. VS is about 3,600 tons per annum. Gamma is 1,200 tons per annum.

capital_allocation.claim: CARE Rating reaffirmed long-term and short-term facilities at stable A1 for a total amount of Rs. 21 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: During the quarter, CARE Rating of Bhageria Industries long-term and short-term facilities at a stable A1 for a total amount of Rs. 21 crores, a reflection of our strong balance sheet, prudent capacity structure, and consistent performance.

capital_allocation.claim: The company is long-term debt free and a net cash company.
capital_allocation.quote: Long term debt free, net cash company

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that China was dumping in the past 2-3 years, but has now stopped it.
risks_headwinds.quote: And China was really dumping in the last 2-3 years, but now they have stopped it. So we expect better margins going forward.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial production of Plasticizers is targeted by the end of December 25.
management_commitments.quote: Within a short period, the company announced the commencement of commercial production of a new product line, Plasticizers by the end of December 25, working on the first place is working with the product collection and marketing at the Tarapur facility and the expansion of H-ACID capacity at the same location.

management_commitments.claim: Management intends to break even in the pharma segment in another next 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: We intend to break even in another next 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to file US DMF for Methylcobalamin in November and Japan DMF by December.
management_commitments.quote: Like in November, we are going with the US DMF. And by December, we will be filing the Japan DMF for Methylcobalamin.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
